title: Integration test DB-swap is dead code; tests share ./books.db with no isolation
evidence: tests/integration.test.ts:20 app.get('bookService') returns undefined (server.ts never calls app.set), so the TestDatabaseService swap is skipped and beforeEach deletes testDbPath which is never used; integration tests run against the file-backed ./books.db created in server.ts:19 and accumulate state across tests
suggestion: Expose the BookService/DB on the app (app.set) or accept an injectable db path in createApp, and clear the actual DB in beforeEach so tests are order-independent

title: Create validation requires year and isbn, stricter than spec (only title/author required)
evidence: src/middleware/validation.ts:26-37 validateCreateBook returns 400 when year or isbn is absent; TASK.md only mandates title and author as required
suggestion: Make year and isbn optional on create (or default them) to match the spec's minimal required-field set

title: README project-structure diagram lists database/database.ts which does not exist
evidence: README.md Project Structure shows src/database/database.ts, but the DB implementation is src/database.ts with a re-export barrel at src/database/index.ts
suggestion: Correct the tree to reflect src/database.ts + src/database/index.ts

title: Unused express type imports in service layer
evidence: src/services/BookService.ts:1 imports Request, Response, NextFunction from express but never uses them
suggestion: Remove the unused imports to keep the service layer framework-agnostic
